fields.title: Write a section
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Feature: user subscribes to a price drop on an item and receives a push. Write the "Data" section covering eight points.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: Entity "Price subscription" — user, catalog item, price at subscription time (snapshot), drop threshold, date. Volume — around hundreds of thousands per quarter. Read — by catalog item on price change, by user for screen. Storage — until unsubscribe or a year of inactivity. On account deletion — deleted. Source of truth internal. Nothing irreversible if catalog item already exists; if not — it's irreversible and discussed separately. Check: can you draw a table from this without questions.
